title: Retail Location
description: A buyer-visible retail location, such as a store, locker, or pickup point.

geo.description: Geographic coordinates for proximity search and map display.

geofence_radius.description: Geofence radius in meters for arrival or proximity experiences.

distance.description: Distance from the buyer's requested or inferred location, when computed by the business.

location_type.description: Location type. Well-known values: store, locker, pickup_point, pop_up. Businesses MAY define additional values using reverse-domain naming.

format.description: Business-defined store format. Well-known values: superstore, express, outlet, standard, urban_small. Businesses MAY define additional values using reverse-domain naming.

status.description: Operational status. Well-known values: open, temporarily_closed, closed, coming_soon. Businesses MAY define additional values using reverse-domain naming.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for this location, such as America/Toronto.

phone.description: Contact phone number for the location. E.164 format is recommended.

fulfillment_capabilities.description: Fulfillment method types this location can support. This does not imply that a specific variant is available.

hours.description: Regular weekly operating hours by day of week. Use exception_hours to override specific dates.

is_closed.description: If true, the location is closed on this day. When true, intervals MUST be omitted.

is_24_hours.description: If true, the location is open 24 hours on this day. When true, intervals MUST be omitted.

intervals.description: One or more open intervals for this day. For overnight hours, use two entries across two days.

open.description: Opening time in local HH:MM 24-hour format.

close.description: Closing time in local HH:MM 24-hour format.

exception_hours.description: Exception hours for specific dates, such as holidays, remodels, temporary closures, or special events. Entries override weekly hours for the given local date.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD, local to the location's timezone.

label.description: Reason for the exception, such as Thanksgiving or Store Remodel.

is_closed.description: If true, the location is closed on this date.

is_24_hours.description: If true, the location is open 24 hours on this date.
